intro-section.text:
The CCRA now offers the options of hosting a “full” CCRA rodeo, a “timed event only” rodeo or a “roughstock only” rodeo. A timed event only rodeo will consist of tie down roping, breakaway roping, ladies barrel racing, ribbon roping, team roping and steer wrestling. All rodeos must follow the CCRA rule book to be sanctioned. Please contact the committee representative or your event director with any questions.

If anyone is interested in hosting a CCRA Rodeo or if you have any questions,
please contact our Rodeo Committee Representative:
Gina Icenoggle (541) 969-2244

instructions.text:
Below is the rodeo information package and approval forms (Fill out online or download & print).

Please fill out the form and submit it along with your approval fees, certificate of insurance, and medical services contact info to the office no later than 45 days before your rodeo dates to insure approval and proper advertising.

   *Please note that approval fees must be paid for each rodeo.  ie: 2 rodeos = 2 approval fees (2 x $150)
instructions.detail: Approval fees of $150 per rodeo (not per location), must be paid after your form is filled in.
